title: kramastotra — kram-p08-v08
question: In varied beginningness, in melted rule: what taste — from partitionlessness, supreme fullness unequalled? The self's yoking of lights, all-being-thing-oneness, by unopposed dharma-floods: supreme knowing, priceless-fit-qualified.
issue: Derived from L2 text (no argmap). In varied beginningness, in melted rule: what taste — from partitionlessness, supreme fullness unequalled? The self's yoking of lights, all-being-thing-oneness, by unopposed dharma-floods: supreme knowing, priceless-fit-qualified.

premises.text: itīdṛkṣair rūpair varada vividhaṃ te kila vapur vibhāti svāṃśe 'smin jagati gatabhedaṃ bhagavataḥ | tad evaitatstotuṃ hṛdayam atha gīrbāhyakaraṇaprabandhāś ca syur me satatam aparityaktarabhasaḥ
